initial_check_failure: Git normalized CRLF in the bound generated SVG when staging; index digest differed from the canonical on-disk digest
root_cause: The inherited * text=auto eol=lf Git attribute
fix: A -text attribute scoped to this one SVG, followed by exact-file git add --renormalize; no figure bytes edited
initial_fix_trial: Ordinary git add retained cached LF index bytes; the read-only check caught this. A provenance attempt failed before creating a record because the asserted receipt was absent.
